Gold.note: Central bank buying and rate cut expectations drive safe-haven demand.

Silver.note: Strong industrial demand coupled with monetary premium and tight physical markets.

Copper.note: Structural supply deficits and electrification demand outweigh near-term macro headwinds.

Uranium.note: Secondary supply depletion and renewed global nuclear capacity buildouts tighten the market.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply from new capacity and moderating EV demand growth weigh on prices.

Nickel.note: Persistent surplus from Indonesian NPI and MHP expansions pressures margins.

Zinc.note: Smelter treatment charge collapses and mine supply disruptions support prices.

Iron Ore.note: Ongoing structural weakness in Chinese real estate offsets infrastructure stimulus efforts.

Coal.note: High global inventories and normalized seaborne trade limit upside despite geopolitical premiums.

Rare Earths.note: Weak magnet demand and increased Chinese supply keep the market heavily oversupplied.

Manganese.note: Sluggish global steelmaking rates constrain manganese alloy demand.

PGM.note: Substitution effects and weak auto production in key markets cap upside.

Potash.note: Steady global agricultural planting rates and restricted Eastern European exports support prices.

Aluminum.note: Chinese production caps and rising green-energy demand offset weak traditional construction sectors.

Diversified.note: Balanced exposure to copper and iron ore provides resilient cash flows despite mixed macro signals.
